summary: Through the relay: the ready frame, then an LTP subscription takes the instrument's market-feed topic; a 188-byte MWBOCombined (186 plus the bridge's slack) and an exact 186-byte one become LTP frames with the trade time in ms; a shorter payload is dropped.

notes: The relay frames (ready text, sub/unsub JSON, PUBLISH binary) are the desktop's own (brokers/iiflcapital/mqtt_relay.rs); the web glue unwraps the PUBLISH frame and hands the web the same topic and payload.

deviations.reason: The web passes IIFL's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
